about: Dancin' Bois is a short, grainy compilation GIF that cuts between unrelated people dancing with total commitment: a big guy in a black apron throwing his arms out in front of a brick wall, a kid in sunglasses spinning in a dark club, a Simpsons character shuffling across a classroom, and more, all stamped with a small watermark. None of it matches, and that is the point. It is pure celebration energy, the visual version of you and your friends losing it when something good happens.
usage:
Top box: the moment worth celebrating, usually written as "me and the boys when...". Bottom box: optional extra detail, or leave it empty so the dancing fills the frame.

It works for small victories shared by a group: the food arriving, a teacher cancelling class, the last level beaten, payday hitting. Because the clips change constantly, keep the caption general enough to fit every dancer.
ideas: me and the boys when the pizza arrives
the whole class when the teacher says "free period"
me and the boys at 12:01 on payday
the squad after winning one ranked match
the office when the wifi comes back
